Hero.description: I develop secure, scalable, and high-performance solutions.

About.headline: Beyond code, engineering.
About.paragraph1: I am a developer focused on building secure and high-performance solutions. I learn by doing—mastering complex concepts through real-world projects rather than isolated study.
About.paragraph2: My main focus is web & mobile development, software quality assurance (QA), and security-by-design. Holding a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science (Systems Security option) from the University of Yaoundé I, I combine a strong academic foundation with 3 years of hands-on field experience.
About.paragraph3: I master modern software technologies, databases, and foundational DevOps practices under Linux and Windows. I love the challenge of designing fast, reliable, structured, and secure applications from the ground up.

Skills.description: The technologies and practices I use to design, develop, and maintain software applications.

responsibilities: Develop web interfaces adapted to various screen sizes.

responsibilities: Participated in the UML design and modeling of the collection system (using Kobo Tools), reporting, processing, and publication.
Participated in functional testing of the SINSAH platform, reducing production bugs by 30%.
Participated in the train-the-trainer workshop for the SINSAH platform.

gbc.description: Developed a mobile banking collection application for microfinance institutions: Gold Bank Collection.
responsibilities: Developed and maintained the application on Android Studio (Java) with an SQLite database.
Tested & debugged the application, improving banking operations by 20%.
